C1371.title: Cross-Chain Bridge Attacks: 49 Incidents from 2021 to 2024
C1371.summary: A study collected 49 cross-chain bridge attack incidents occurring between June 2021 and September 2024, with 22 targeting bridge business logic. These attacks resulted in total losses of approximately $4.3 billion.

references.title: Safeguarding Blockchain Ecosystem: Understanding and Detecting Attack Transactions on Cross-Chain Bridges
